capabilities: Create and edit one-time and recurring tasks in configurable vault folders
Track task progress, due dates, execution dates, and subtasks
Archive completed tasks as Markdown files
Run a configurable Pomodoro timer with sound notifications
Split tasks into subtasks using DeepSeek models
extras: Documentation is bilingual (English and Chinese). The README explains that AI task splitting is off by default and sends task titles, descriptions, and optional prompt file contents to DeepSeek, with no telemetry or background network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tool for managing recurring tasks with progress tracking, due dates, and timeboxing in one place.

relations.evidence: It stores tasks as Markdown files in your vault and can optionally use DeepSeek to split a task into actionable subtasks.

summary: Task manager and Pomodoro timer that stores tasks as Markdown files in the vault, with optional DeepSeek-powered subtask splitting.
